name: the game's light
about: Sean's pick (2026-10-23, issue #321): B by day, C at night. LightLooks blends every dial the two set from day's to night's as the sun goes down: all day's with the sun over night_from_sun (its height, the sun direction's y; ~0.26 is 15 degrees up), all night's under night_full_sun. The sky's own dials stay day's (each change re-lights the sky); the grade steps in grade_steps (each step its own lookup, built once).
night_values_about: Light pass round 3 (issue #412, 2026-10-27): the game's night over light C's, so C's own file stays as it was for 8. The saloon's room lit warm all over as the painting's is, not pools in black (the judge on the saloon shot 1.20 -> 0.44: deep shadow 0.56 -> 0.12, midtones 7 -> 28): its fill (the room's ambient probe, in the lamps' gold: SaloonDressing.ROOM_FILL_COLOUR) up, its lamps' falloff softer and reaching further so their pools spread; the night grade's S of contrast down, the blacks lifted a touch, the oranges kept and a touch more colour, the shade warm, the vignette lighter.
